prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead three-quarter view of one hand-built relief model in three zones from left to right: flat layered paper-cut coastline contours in graded blues, a pale-line blueprint frame drawn on deep blue card, and a field of small six-sided hexagon tiles standing like terrain. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass at the seam between the blueprint zone and the tile field. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.

The top edge of the photograph cuts through the middle of the torso, well below the collar. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass at the seam between the blueprint zone and the tile field of the model.
